source: Read-only synthesis of reports/round-21/defects/sweep-r17.md through sweep-r20.md, rounds 17-20 regression and validation evidence, and Round-21 recount/control reports. Historical files were not rewritten.

entries.defect: R17 closure records mislabel the declaration commit as the baseline.
entries.owner_note: Add a dated correction in an authorized new integration record; keep LOG.md and SCORECARD.md historical text intact.
entries.evidence: Filed claim and receipt name baseline f30b6f8188937632bbedd0e7b29aeefff6f8b07b. Closure text calls 9b49a4a the baseline; git show identifies 9b49a4a as the R17 claims declaration.

entries.defect: Route capacity / declared-worker arithmetic: R17 declares 64 workers while targets allocate 60 seats.
entries.fix_scope: R18 declaration allocation only; no rewrite of R17 declarations
entries.before: R17 claims declare 64 workers; target-seat sum is 60.
entries.after: R18 claims still declare 64 workers and R18 target allocations sum to 64 (20+28+10+6).
entries.control: Round-21 fix-09 read-only arithmetic control; reports/round-18/scope.md §4 independently records the balanced allocation.
entries.owner_note: Mismatch is closed at declaration level. Actual R17 dispatch or attendance is not established; verify only if an operator dispatch log exists, and do not infer staffing from JSON arithmetic.
entries.evidence: The R17 receipt treated the mismatch as informational; R18 reconciles the declared target allocation. This does not prove actual dispatch.

entries.defect: R17 claim D was rejected for missing typed D4 artifact/projection/expected-holds and frozen-manifest evidence.
entries.fix_scope: R18 repair and controls; preserve R17 receipt and rejection
entries.before: R17 validation records D failure for missing D4 typed artifact, projection, expected-holds and frozen manifest.
entries.after: R18 receipt records C/D/O passed; R21 independently reproduces the D4 gate at 19/19 and D2 default output identity.
entries.owner_note: Keep the R17 rejection as filed; R18 repair does not retroactively change the R17 verdict.
entries.evidence: R17 remains historically rejected. Later R18 evidence closes the missing-input condition only for the subsequent round; the Round-21 recount reproduces the R18 19/19 and D2 byte-identity controls.

entries.defect: Current-tree recount differs from the filed R17 receipt; C changes from pass to fail and D/O fail on present-byte checks.
entries.owner_note: Determine and document cause/attribution in a new recount disposition. Do not amend the R17 receipt or infer that the current tree changes its historical result.
entries.evidence: R17 C recorded 5 attempts/7 fixed/16 fragments; current recount observes 0/0/0 and C pass→fail. D4 component and D2/D3 path counts match, but examples/culture-d2/expected-holds.json changed from SHA a5dc26d5… to 7b9439c4…; adapter builds exit 2 and an adapter pin mismatches. Current R17 frozen manifest replays 5/5. These are current-tree observations, not retroactive receipt corrections; cause is unestablished.

entries.defect: No lane-local final R18 report was found; external filing is unverified.
entries.owner_note: Request or record a pointer to any authorized external final report; do not represent the repo-only search as proof no report exists.
entries.evidence: The repository inventory and local path checks found no lane-local final report. The audit explicitly did not inspect the external fleet root; R18 remains admitted in parent records.

entries.defect: R18 admission records label the declaration commit as baseline instead of the R17 close.
entries.owner_note: Record the correct baseline in a new authorized integration note; preserve LOG.md and SHONEN.md as filed.
entries.evidence: Claims and receipt declare 3dd3754207032cb81f5fb3e202fe85cf79211339 (R17 close); closure records call c66ac3c (the R18 claims declaration) the baseline. R18 green receipt is not overturned by this metadata mismatch.

entries.defect: Original R18 D4 frozen replay row is superseded by the later projection and remains non-reproducible.
entries.owner_note: Add a successor frozen generation or explicit supersession record with fresh digest and replay evidence. Do not edit the original R18 manifest.
entries.evidence: R21 isolated replay exits 1 with 1/2 rows reproduced; row 2 records projection a59990bb… while current projection is cbcf997f…. R18 append-only D2 repin replays 11/11; the original manifest remains untouched.

entries.defect: R19 scribe-seat failure required an integrator-authored harness; recurrence prevention and the original cause remain unresolved.
entries.owner_note: Define a named scribe-failure trigger, fallback owner, and retained handoff receipt. Do not infer the failure cause or replace the filed R19 receipt.
entries.evidence: The R19 receipt states 'integrator-authored harness (scribe seat failed); all measurements re-run at close'; the close-time fallback is documented, but the reason for seat failure remains to-verify.

entries.defect: Same-path assignment collision: R19-D08 and X21 both targeted corpus/lessons/round-19.md; parent disposition remains open.
entries.owner_note: Choose and record the lesson disposition/pointer with authorship retained. Do not rewrite the filed lesson or D4 fragment in this ledger.
entries.evidence: X21's survey superseded D08's draft at the assigned path; the D4 entry remains at reports/round-19/integration/d4-lessons-entry.md. The R20 audit found the integration debt still open.

entries.defect: The lane-local R19 report remains a non-final draft; external final filing is unverified.
entries.owner_note: Request or record a pointer to an authorized final report; retain the stamped draft and distinguish this repo-only finding from external filing.
entries.evidence: In-repository path checks found no kotodama.md and the report draft states the parent owns final filing. The external fleet root was not inspected.

entries.defect: R19 acceptance receipt and parent closure records bind to the R19 declaration rather than the declared R18-admit baseline.
entries.owner_note: Reconcile in a new authorized record or remeasurement; do not rewrite the filed receipt or infer a new acceptance result.
entries.evidence: Claims declare e5718945a1ab0a0c3db955338d2cae77d68fd348 (R18 admit); receipt and parent records use 169c616 (R19 declaration). Receipt acceptance true does not repair the baseline binding mismatch.

entries.defect: F-O13-1: R19 D4 typed adapter selftest failed because its mirror omitted the serializer peer and its routing guard compared the wrong operands.
entries.fix_scope: R20 adapter/selftest repair and regression control
entries.before: R19 tools/assemble-d4-typed.py --selftest exited 1 with 4/11 checks; production --check remained green.
entries.after: R20 regression and R21 regression both report tools/assemble-d4-typed.py --selftest exit 0 with 12/12 checks.
entries.owner_note: Closed by the R20/R21 controls; preserve the original R19 finding and do not reopen from the superseded failure alone.
entries.evidence: R19 failure was selftest-only; later measured selftests are green and the production check remains byte-identical.

entries.defect: F-O13-2: the R19 gate battery made a flagless D4 adapter answer --selftest, producing an unevaluable battery and claim-O blocker.
entries.fix_scope: R20 battery/adapter control and regression coverage
entries.before: R19 default battery exited 2 with 8 pass and 1 unevaluable due to d4-assembly-check-gate.py lacking --selftest.
entries.after: R20 and R21 battery controls exit 0 with pass 7, unevaluable 0; the normal D4 adapter packet check is green.
entries.owner_note: The flagless gate is not itself a defect; the battery contract mismatch is closed by later green battery evidence.
entries.evidence: The original --selftest exit 2 is an expected gate CLI outcome; the defect was the battery treating that CLI as required. R20 resolves the regression with an exit-zero battery, pass 7, unevaluable 0.

entries.defect: Mirror-faithfulness wart: D4 alias handling depended on the foreign D2 component/tree, which could mask a broken family boundary.
entries.fix_scope: R20 per-family alias resolution and D4-only mirror controls
entries.before: R20 interim probe without examples/culture-d2 failed on the missing D2 component; adapter selftest mirror copied the foreign tree.
entries.after: Final R20 receipt marks foreign_tree_copy_in_adapter false; D4 projector and adapter checks pass in a mirror without examples/culture-d2.
entries.owner_note: Closed by final R20 controls and independently reproduced R21 checks; do not rely on the in-flight interim review alone.
entries.evidence: R20 D4-only mirror probes pass without the D2 tree, D2 output remains byte-identical, and the adapter selftest is 12/12.

entries.defect: No authorized lane-local final R20 report was found; external final filing remains unverified.
entries.owner_note: Request or record the authorized report pointer; do not infer external absence from this repository-only search.
entries.evidence: The local draft is explicitly non-final and no lane-local kotodama.md was present; the parent records R20 admitted. External filing was not inspected.

entries.defect: R20 parent closure records mislabel the R20 declaration as baseline instead of the R19 admission.
entries.owner_note: Add a dated correction in a new authorized integration record; preserve historical LOG.md and SHONEN.md text.
entries.evidence: Claims and receipt name caf1beac19b55f3bbce47e4a9e7e8710cc1c581d (R19 admit); parent records call 122086b (R20 declaration) the baseline.

entries.defect: A live historical-validator run transiently rewrote a protected R9 receipt, changing acceptance true→false before restoration; duplicate R20 accounts are consolidated here.
entries.owner_note: Keep historical validators out of the live lane; define/reinforce isolated-clone controls and verify protected receipt hashes before and after any authorized rerun. Do not rewrite the restored receipt.
entries.evidence: R20 evidence records the R9 receipt changing acceptance true→false and restoration by 13:03:17Z. Regression F-O15-2 covers the same event's R5/R7/R9 transient edits (R5/R7 were outside the declared 8–19 freeze); this ledger does not duplicate the R9 incident. Current committed protected files were later compared clean, which does not erase the transient write.

entries.defect: Current isolated R20 --check fails its selected contract-audit check while the filed R20 receipt remains green; cause is unresolved.
entries.owner_note: Reconcile the selected audit artifact and receipt evidence without rewriting historical files; document cause only when reproduced and bounded.
entries.evidence: At HEAD 8115eaa an isolated `python3 reports/round-20/run-validation.py --check` exited 1: C/O passed and D failed because the selected contract-audit artifact was classified fail. The filed receipt says acceptance true and all C/D/O pass. The R20 receipt's runner hash matches the current runner, but that does not explain the check discrepancy.

entries.defect: R20 handoff link count differs between the filed packet and independent current replay.
entries.owner_note: Reconcile the three-link difference and record an append-only disposition; do not silently replace the filed 102/102 count.
entries.evidence: Current packet_links replay and v3 exercise each report 105/105 with no findings; the filed packet records 102/102 at 2026-10-18T13:14:00Z. Cause is unknown and the filed count was not reproduced.

entries.defect: Fragment-index collision class: two independently authored indexes coexist at different paths, leaving canonical ownership unresolved; this was not a same-path overwrite.
entries.owner_note: Select or generate a canonical index pointer after the artifact set settles. Keep both peer-owned snapshots intact; do not claim either one is authoritative without parent decision.
entries.evidence: reports/round-20/fragment-index.md and fragment-index-x24.md coexist. X24's own inventory control reports 72 indexed/72 observed with no unindexed paths, but does not establish canonical ownership.

entries.defect: Malformed declared era-alias values are stringified and applied as confirmed instead of being rejected or held (fail-open).
entries.owner_note: Reject non-string or grammar-invalid tags before projection and add a named negative control; verify the full CLI path in an isolated fixture before closure.
entries.evidence: R20 M9 and the R21 direct helper probe show `era_aliases: {"era-9": [1, 2]}` becomes tag `[1, 2]` (stringified) with status confirmed. The R21 probe did not exercise the full packet/CLI path; end-to-end refusal remains unverified.

entries.defect: An intermediate R20 validation receipt was observed bound to a superseded runner; the final receipt was later verified against the live runner.
entries.fix_scope: Final receipt re-binding completed in the R20 wave; preserve the intermediate observation
entries.before: X24's index recorded an earlier green receipt with runner SHA 6da4… while the then-live runner had changed.
entries.after: The final R20 receipt's runner_sha256 matches the live R20 runner; receipt timestamp is later than runner timestamp.
entries.control: reports/round-21/defects/fix-15.md:1-15; independent current hash check recorded in the R21 task evidence.
entries.owner_note: Do not carry the interim state as an unresolved final binding defect; retain the history and verify final receipts before future status claims.
entries.evidence: The final R20 validation receipt SHA and runner SHA are bound as checked on 2026-10-18. Hash agreement establishes byte binding only, not measurement correctness.

entries.defect: R20 claim C declares 20 linguistics entries while the live tree and reconciled README count 19; the delta is explicitly documented.
entries.owner_note: Keep the declared-vs-live delta explicit in future coverage claims; no unexplained discrepancy or silent correction is established here.
entries.evidence: Current counts are 94/19/19/18/29/20 (199 total); the README explicitly names the R20 claim's 20-vs-19 linguistics difference. R20 claim C passed with the difference documented.
